nohup bash -c '
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1

PY=/root/miniconda3/bin/python

echo "[$(date)] START chain" > $LOGDIR/cls8b_ablation_chain.log

for CKPT in 2200 3600 6633; do

  echo "[$(date)] Starting ckpt-${CKPT}" >> $LOGDIR/cls8b_ablation_chain.log
  $PY /root/autodl-tmp/code/eval_repo_cls.py \
    --checkpoint_dir $CD/checkpoint-${CKPT} \
    --model_name $MODEL \
    --data_dir $DATA \
    --output $OUTPATH/eval_summary.json \
    --pred_output $OUTPATH/predictions.jsonl \
    --batch_size 8 \
    --max_seq_length 4096 \
    --split test \
    --device cuda:0 \
    > $LOGDIR/cls8b_ckpt${CKPT}_eval.log 2>&1
  echo "[$(date)] ckpt-${CKPT} done, exit=$?" >> $LOGDIR/cls8b_ablation_chain.log
done

echo "[$(date)] ALL DONE" >> $LOGDIR/cls8b_ablation_chain.log
' > /dev/null 2>&1 &
echo "PID=$!"
